assertions.name: electron_block_zero_framing_residual_any_f
assertions.source: The electron block (3,1,1) is the unique self-conjugate n=5 partition (content sum c=0), so its framing residual theta_lambda^f = q0^{f*c} = 1 for any Seifert framing f. Hence the geometric colored-WRT vacuum row equals the Verlinde value d_q/D at q0 exactly for this block -- no archimedean continuation, discharging the #3681 Habiro-rigidity carrier concretely. No fit; f-independent.

assertions.name: content_sum_chirality_c_conj_eq_neg_c
assertions.source: c(lambda')=-c(lambda) on every conjugate pair (the proved twist chirality law theta_{lambda'}=theta_lambda^{-1}); the residual q0^{f*c} is opposite on a pair and vanishes exactly on the self-conjugate electron block.

description: Geometric W_lambda: the fibre->observable q0 residual reduces to the framing monomial theta_lambda^f = q0^{f*c(lambda)} (d_q(lambda)=[mark]_q is a global Laurent polynomial; no Habiro completion needed for it). The content sum c(lambda) satisfies c(lambda')=-c(lambda) and c=0 iff lambda self-conjugate; the ONLY self-conjugate n=5 block is the electron (3,1,1) (A5-split mark-6 McKay node), so it has c=0 => theta^f=1 for ANY framing f => bwS0Concrete((3,1,1))(q0)=([5]_q0+1)/D EXACTLY, no archimedean continuation. Discharges the #3681 Habiro-rigidity carrier concretely for the electron block; every other block carries the explicit residual q0^{f*c(lambda)} (per-block quantified open piece). No fit; the c=0 electron result is f-independent.
